quarter.zh: 2026 财年第四季（10 月季度）

en: A record quarter: revenue rose 53% to $10.41B against ~$10.3B expected, and non-GAAP EPS of $4.16 beat $4.06, as DRAM reached a third of chip-tool sales and advanced packaging hit a record. The Q1 guide of $11.1B ±$0.5B and $4.35 EPS tops the ~$10.85B and ~$4.24 consensus, with gross margin edging up to about 50.8%. CEO Gary Dickerson expects chip-tool spending to grow over 30% in 2027, led by DRAM and leading-edge logic, and plans to double systems output by 2028 as cleanroom space gates the pace.

The stock fell 3.6% to $380.95 on Nov 12 as chip stocks slid on the day Nvidia's CEO resigned, then rose about 1–1.5% after hours on the beat and guide. The gain did not hold: on Nov 13 AMAT closed down 2.7% at $370.50 as the Nvidia fallout and AI-valuation worries kept pressure on chip names, and Stifel and Mizuho trimmed price targets. The shares sit near half their June high despite the stronger outlook.
zh: 创纪录的一季：营收增长 53% 至 104.1 亿美元，高于约 103 亿美元的预期；非 GAAP 每股收益 4.16 美元，超过 4.06 美元的预期。DRAM 占芯片设备销售的三分之一，先进封装收入创新高。第一季指引营收 111 亿美元（±5 亿）、每股收益 4.35 美元，高于约 108.5 亿美元和约 4.24 美元的市场预期，毛利率小幅升至约 50.8%。CEO 盖瑞·迪克森预计 2027 年芯片设备支出增长逾 30%，DRAM 和先进逻辑领跑；洁净室空间制约扩张速度，公司计划到 2028 年将系统产能翻倍。
11 月 12 日英伟达 CEO 辞职当天芯片股走低，应用材料下跌 3.6% 至 380.95 美元；财报超预期、指引强劲，盘后上涨约 1–1.5%。但涨幅未能保持：11 月 13 日，英伟达风波余震和 AI 估值担忧继续压制芯片股，股价收跌 2.7% 至 370.50 美元，Stifel 和瑞穗下调目标价。尽管展望更强，股价仍仅约为 6 月高点的一半。

bio.en: CEO since 2013. Previously CEO of Varian Semiconductor, which Applied bought in 2011, and earlier spent 18 years at KLA-Tencor. Has pushed Applied toward materials engineering for AI chips, such as gate-all-around transistors and advanced packaging.
bio.zh: 2013 年起任 CEO。此前任瓦里安半导体 CEO（应用材料于 2011 年收购），更早在科磊工作 18 年。推动应用材料聚焦 AI 芯片材料工程，如环绕栅极晶体管和先进封装。

bio.en: CFO since March 2022, joining from Xilinx, where he was CFO. Spent most of his 25-year career at Intel, leading finance for many of its largest businesses and functions.
bio.zh: 2022 年 3 月起任 CFO，此前任赛灵思 CFO。25 年职业生涯大部分在英特尔，负责多个最大业务与职能部门的财务。

sources.t: Guide vs consensus and after-hours move (Investing.com)
